summary: Accept stdin JSON:API bodies on twelve promoted write shortcuts; upload image bytes as multipart with sparse fields in live and dry-run requests; expose QA gate errors; preserve compact attributes including created and updated; retry identity-probe 429/5xx responses honoring delta-seconds and HTTP-date Retry-After with a 30-second cap; page segment tags at 10 items.
reason: Published write shortcuts must send the required bodies without losing precision, query flags, validation, or deletion/unsubscription guidance. Image uploads must send file bytes rather than a local path while preserving auth, revision, endpoint budgets, safe retries, and metadata-only dry runs. QA errors must remain visible, compact lists must retain useful JSON:API attributes, tenant probes must tolerate transient throttling with four attempts and cancellable 1s/2s/4s fallback waits, and tagged segment snapshots must follow paginated relationships and the supported single-segment count field. Keep revision 2026-04-15 unchanged.
validated_outcome: go build ./... and go vet ./... pass; all test packages compile, and TestFixPassCompactListFields passes, including created and updated under attributes. Unit tests assert exact stdin bodies, validation errors, multipart bytes and headers, sparse-field paths in requests and dry-run output, QA errors, compact nested attributes, probe retry waits and outcomes including HTTP dates and the 30-second cap, context cancellation, and segment/tag pagination with matching snapshots. HTTP test execution is unverified in this sandbox because local listening sockets are denied. A live run against a real Klaviyo account is also unverified in this task: real API calls are prohibited. The orchestrator must run the full test gate and supply live-run evidence before either validation is claimed as passed.
